info.title: Attack on Titan: PATHS API
info.description: Read-only, spoiler-aware access to the PATHS knowledge graph. Every data endpoint takes `cutoff`, the last chapter the reader has read; nothing revealed after it is ever returned.

get.summary: PATHS mode: how an entity connects across time
get.description: Titan lineages, lifetimes, events, memories (including memories received before they happened) and causes, laid out as lanes (docs/features/paths-mode.md). Computed on the reader's spoiler-filtered graph.

parameters.name: cutoff
parameters.description: The last manga chapter the reader has read. Nothing revealed later is returned.

supported.description: False for places and groups, which PATHS mode doesn't follow.

get.summary: Events the reader knows about, in world or story order
get.description: `world` orders events by when they happened (docs/model/dates.md §4); `story` orders them by the chapter that reveals them (docs/model/spoilers.md §8). Events whose date isn't revealed yet come last in world order.

parameters.name: cutoff
parameters.description: The last manga chapter the reader has read. Nothing revealed later is returned.

revealedIn.description: The chapter where the reader learns of this event.

get.summary: Find entities by name, description or connection, optionally in a year
get.description: Every word must match the entity's names, a revealed description, or a connected entity's name. A standalone number (`850`) restricts to that year. Only what the reader has reached takes part in matching.

parameters.name: cutoff
parameters.description: The last manga chapter the reader has read. Nothing revealed later is returned.

year.description: The year searched in, if any.

detail.description: What matched: a name, a description paragraph, or a connected name.
